summary: Avnet Inc. filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, reporting Amendment No. 9 to its Fourth Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement. The amendment increases the maximum purchase limit from $500M to $700M, extends the termination date to July 1, 2028, and excludes certain receivables. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event are involved. Watch for future changes in receivables financing or liquidity updates.
